text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—It is time.
I shall be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Maintenance, self-care, and training...
I have given my all to fulfill every duty expected of me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Meticulously, thoroughly, leaving no room for doubt in my heart.
All of that has now become my confidence.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: In other words—anxiety is completely foreign to me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Heh, allow me to prove it with results.
